only_change: Android adds existing actions/download-artifact@v4 name=validated-foundry path=resources/foundry/ before install/build. Exactly same four-line consumer used by core_checks/core/windows/web.
reason: Job dependencies gate success but do not copy resources across isolated checkout workspaces. Android transitively depends on prepare via core/windows/web yet receives only tracked old resources/foundry. The same source/export guard necessarily rejects that old batch if reached, as the recorded current-source stamp check demonstrates. Existing download without run-id selects the same workflow run artifact; no cross-run restore or bypass is added.

baseline_failure.observation: root actual optimized-engine stamp returned1 before export; reviewer read log only

canonical_pool_recommendation.count_semantics: Existing defaults base/double_jump/air_chain produce24+6+6=36 accepted development phrases. Do not change --count to36; that would produce36+9+9=54 and change scope.
canonical_pool_recommendation.preserve: Retain old batch/replays/stamp and failed stamp evidence externally, run original guarded validator at frozen final source, inspect genuine produced canonical resources/foundry diff; only then commit rebuilt development batch/replays/stamp. No hand-edited basis/SHA, no production-pool promotion or fun/visual approval.
canonical_pool_recommendation.basis_note: Foundry source basis covers actual bounded scripts/resources and engine string. Final source must be stable before rebuilding. Metadata-only/workflow change does not itself justify altering runtime rules.

limits: No engine invocation or main writes by reviewer.
This patch fixes handoff; Android SDK installation, real APK export and platform execution remain separate validations.
